title: Control rotation through MQTT
body:
Would it be possible for MQTT to allow access to and to change the screen rotation of the RPi?

Thanks for creating this, so much better than using the browser and was working immediately once I ran through the setup script - nice job 👍
author: Taomyn

comments.body:
Yes, i think it should be implementable, with a select box to switch between the four rotation modes.
Can I ask what the use case for this is, since I'm thinking this would be a once in a time adjustment?

Yes you're correct that it's not going to be needed often, but would be useful I think.

I don't really have a particular use case, I just thought after having issues with orientation of the display and VNC mouse control earlier after switching to Wayland, being able to set the orientation also through MQTT would be a good addition.
